summary: PASS on candidate sha256:84130c62... (commit 1e4c0226). Every required check ran and passed in fresh complete --no-local clones: extraction, 66/66 gate tests, 39/39 node and 22 Python agent tests, register/pipeline/reconcile, candidate recomputation, and pre-freeze 11/11. The full-history dry-run has 0 PRUNED/RECORD-LESS/DROPPED errors and no closure-anchor or 'object, not a commit' error; only round-not-finished and harness artefacts remain. D-045 works: my round-28 QA28-T7 case (a tag-object round source_commit) is accepted by the pre-D-045 validator and rejected by the candidate with exactly the D-045 error. Nested tags, tree-tags, bare trees and blobs are rejected too, including in closure-free rounds that no closure anchor covers. A genuinely absent round source_commit is still tolerated, while a closure in such a round is still rejected by D-042. A forged tag on real round 27 is rejected. F-DG0-251 is CLOSED_VERIFIED. The standing strict controls hold (14/14), the r27/r28 suites pass, and the census finds every present commit-id field to be a commit object. Register integrity, agent evidence, live guard probes and A01-A28 feasibility are all clean. No new findings. This is an engineering DG0 review only: it grants no business, Finance or IT approval, and it implies nothing about product gates G1-G6.
